terra.problem: The explanation is flat and generic, ending with a procedural comment rather than Papa Dorin's voice.
The explanation repeats the distinction without much personality or a natural laugh where one could fit.
“Disciples only” is too broad. His brothers also tell Him to show Himself to the world in verse 4.
Calling the question a trap comments on the lesson's own question.
The claim that crowds follow Jesus all over the place draws on material outside this passage without a reference.
John 5 comes before John 7, not later. John 5:16 describes persecution over His works on the Sabbath; the explicit charge of breaking the Sabbath appears in John 5:18.
The passage reports some comments from the crowd, but does not establish that nobody said anything about Jesus hiding.

“Everybody had an opinion” goes beyond the text, which says many were whispering. It also assigns everyone a desire not to speak aloud; the text gives fear of the Jews as the reason no one spoke publicly.
